notes: Adding a device no longer makes you re-type a login you already saved. The Add Device screen now lets you "Use existing" — pick a saved credential from a dropdown (name · username · description) — or "Create new" as before.

Reuse means one shared login is stored once: change that password in one place and every device using it is updated. The password is never shown in the dialog; it stays encrypted and is only used at connect time.
